candidate_law: all nonzero integer (a,b) in [-B,B]^2, ascending frozen Decimal quadratic height score, then a,b
target_law: uniform over all q-1 nonidentity points; enumerate every scalar k=1,...,q-1 exactly once; scalar labels are an audit oracle, not supplied to an online solver
first_hit: first candidate index i whose residue (a+R_over_Q*b) mod q equals k; stop candidate scan once all q-1 first hits are recorded
statistics: retain every target first-hit row, exact sum and rational mean, median-times-two, nearest-rank p90, maximum, and exact combinatorial q/2 lower-bound comparison
claim_boundary: secondary exhaustive target-distribution analysis after the frozen six single-target comparisons; candidate counts only, no shared-setup amortized wall-time or Tier 0/1 speedup claim
